Record detailed scoped evidence in existing issue/PR or prior immutable Git snapshot; preserve exact commit/path/blob and relevant key. Checkpoint next is subordinate to original task and current owner decision; before resumption verify exit criteria and actual missing acceptance evidence. If mismatch, correct it; do not reopen accepted scope. After each unit close a real gate or identify a concrete unresolved blocker.
